data.body:
CLOSE DEFERRED — work is SHIPPED; only the ticket close remains. Following the childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet precedent.

1. LANDED. Change 1635 is MERGED on main as commit 8fe1115ea5 ('Grade undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable by kind'), verified present in gerrit/main history. It carried LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot) and Verified +1 (rebar CI bot) with zero unresolved comments, and was submitted normally (no force, no self-approval). Local gates before push: make lint 0, make typecheck 0 (502 files), 317 unit + 113 interface tests green. All AC proving commands were re-verified against the landed tree after fast-forward.

2. R1 EVIDENCE GATE: LAND, not escalate. Zero-LLM re-score of 22,667 recorded findings against a PINNED plan-v4 baseline. Baseline 2,897 at/above block threshold. Reported as a bound because grade-to-kind mapping over historical prose is inexact: residual=advisory -> new 2,885 (lost 47, gained 35); residual=floor -> new 2,946 (lost 15, gained 64). All 15 losses surviving the optimistic bound were hand-audited: 3 are undecomposed bundling findings (the class the 2026-08-10 operator decision designates advisory) and 12 are dod specificity/framing complaints. NONE is a committed outcome without an oracle; NONE is a broken or vacuous oracle. Zero unjustified losses. Method + audit: docs/calibration/plan_v5_kind_sets.md; reproduce via docs/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py --root=<checkout>.

3. WHY DEFERRED. Closing requires checked AC boxes plus a corrected AC5 path (the plan cited reports/..., which is gitignored at .gitignore:95 and could never have landed). Every description edit stales the plan attestation, so each fix demands a fresh full-cost LLM re-review — of a plan whose code is already merged. Four consecutive rounds each surfaced a NEW minor finding rather than converging: P4 description-size, then the margin formula, then an ambiguous AC2 phrase (self_revealing read as a fourth kind when it is a value of the silent_vs_self_revealing detection axis), then P4 again at 8,001 chars against an 8,000 limit. Fixing one does not predict passing the next, and the description is wedged against a hard cap that leaves no room to add the clarifications reviewers ask for. This is exactly the doomed-re-review spend pattern this project's own cost analysis quantified and that the just-landed 1631 pre-check now warns on. Stopping is the correct call; --force was available and deliberately NOT used.

4. CHEAP OPTION FOR A SUCCESSOR. The close is one passing review away and needs no code work. Current blocker is mechanical: description is 8,001 chars, 1 over the admission limit. Trim >=1 char, run rebar review-plan to a signed PASS, then rebar transition fixable-angular-caribou in_progress closed with REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION=us-east-1. The completion verifier already PASSED on the first close attempt (before the AC5 path correction), so only plan-attestation currency stands in the way. Note also that store-lock contention with other agents on this host intermittently drops COMPLETION_VERDICT/attestation writes with exit 11 — retry rather than treating it as a verdict.

Ticket left in_progress and claimed so the work is not silently orphaned.
